title: TRANSMISSION CONTENTS
summary: Contents of the transmission and clutch section (UPC 7): transmission bracket and shift control lever, shift linkage, transmission installation and adjustment, backdrive/interlock linkage, TCS (transmission controlled spark) switch and relay, clutch control shaft (clutch cross shaft / Z-bar) and release (throwout) bearing, and clutch pedal linkage. The overview drawing points each sheet to its area of the manual-transmission drivetrain; View A shows the VIN stamping location on the transmission (specs on UPC 0 sheet B2). All models.
notes: V.I.N. Location See UPC 0 Sheet B2 for specs.
notes_internal: Contents page with an overview drawing; no part callouts. Drawing callouts B2, B3, B5, C1, C2 point to those sheets' areas.
Sheet ids B1-B6 in the left column are heavily blotted; read from their order and the revision record (rev 2 'B5 title revised', rev 3 'B6 added').
Rev 1 date read as 6-7-69 (dash faint); rev 1 AUTH smudged.
